g.text: Which ingredients actually improve a small math model: the RL objective, its hyperparameters,
the data source, or more updates?
Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B base, full-parameter updates (FP32 weights / BF16 compute).
512 MATH Level 3-5 training problems; 300 disjoint development problems (dev300).
External: MATH-500, GSM8K-100, AIME 2025+2026 (60). Greedy unless stated; 3000-token cap.

g.text: Same prompts, grader and cap; matched settings are labeled. Tuning uses dev300 only, never
'...' = incomplete or unavailable; '---' = not evaluated. AIME: 60 problems, one problem = 1.7 points.
Strict re-grading (closed final \boxed{} only): RL scores move <= 0.3 pts;
the base model drops to 33.0 (MATH-500) and 32.0 (GSM8K), so RL gains only grow.

g.text: Why SFT failed, and the fix

text.style: font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #505050

g.text: Imitating terse human solutions moves the model off its own reasoning style.
Original SFT (human MATH solutions, full FT): 40.3% dev300, below the 45.0% base.
Targets average 376 tokens vs ~1,065 for the base model's own answers; outputs
skip steps and copy [asy] diagram code until the cap (71/300 truncated).
Fix (RAFT / rejection-sampling FT): train on the base model's own verified answers.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #505050

g.text: Full LR 5e-6, LoRA LR 1e-4; cosine, 3 epochs, batch 16; same 512-problem source pool.

g.text: Dev300 accuracy across learning rates; then matched-LR training dynamics over the 128-update
Method rankings depend on learning rate; compare matched settings, not raw loss scales.
LR 1e-6, Dr. GRPO minus GRPO: dev300 −4.0 [−7.3, −0.7]; MATH-500 and GSM8K within noise.
Trailing means over 4 rollout logs. 128 updates = one pass over the 512 problems.

g.text: Tuned GRPO (LR 3e-6), same 512 problems repeated four times. Logged training metrics, not held-
Dotted lines: data-pass boundaries. Gray: raw per-update loss. Reward keeps rising on
repeated problems while entropy collapses early and response length shortens.

g.text: Intermediate checkpoints regenerated by validated deterministic replay. Only complete benchmark
cohorts are plotted; missing scheduled points remain gaps.
Complete measured cohorts: Dev300 (development): 19, GSM8K-100: 18, MATH-500: 6.
Gaps are pending or held evaluations, not interpolated results.

g.text: What RL changes: sharper, not broader
Same 100 development questions, eight samples at T = 1. RL mostly concentrates mass on answers
the base model could already reach.
Pass@1 +44 pts vs pass@8 +11; answer entropy (nats) falls 67%.
No measurable forgetting (LR 1e-6): WikiText PPL 24.04 vs 24.11, BoolQ 55.0 vs 54.0, ARC 73.0 vs 73.0.
